grader.scenario: Disputed late payment fee and threat of credit file default notice
grader.notes: Disputed late payment fee and credit default warning call handled by Diana. Customer's direct debit was delayed by August Bank Holiday, triggering an automated £12 fee and a default threat letter. Agent handled empathy and ownership well by waiving the fee and issuing a clean credit certificate, but omitted paraphrasing, failed Probing on banking mandate details, and failed Professionalism with a sarcastic remark.
